method: Reproduce every strict answer grade against its frozen truth and source. Independently hash each cited file, verify exact quotes, parse scripts properties, and check admitted package chains through declared manifests and installed links. Distinct source occurrences are documented separately; this audit does not replace strict grades or gates.
conclusion: All 16 workflows conform. Eleven answers strictly pass. Four strict failures arise only from two individually valid, distinct literal occurrences being collapsed to the same exclusion key. Native runtime repeat 1 also proposes a substantively invalid external development-dependency chain and remains incorrect. Two static impact tasks share the same Vue 3.5.13 corpus; they do not establish actual repair or cross-repository savings.
